purpose: Test whether a held text's grouped-MLP6/7 upstream displacement can be replaced by a direction-and-factor-specific leave-one-row-out prototype while frozen downstream readers still predict its causal margin effect.
data_status: Retrospective diagnostic on the second corpus. Per-row fixed-reader outputs were sealed before causal outcomes, but the corpus-level prototype rule and bars are registered after those artifacts opened; passing licenses a prospective third-corpus prototype export, not identification by itself.

binding_reader_predictions.finding: Contains 512 sealed fixed-reader outputs q_hat=g_direction dot delta_h for 32 rows and all 16 factor subsets.

binding_causal_validation.finding: Contains the corresponding 512 exact-minus-base causal margin effects; fixed readers transfer with perfect signs.

binding_reader_artifact.finding: Defines two frozen 1152-dimensional linear downstream readers.

novelty_audit: Repository searches for fixed upstream displacement, LOO head delta prototype, reader-coupled displacement, target-free upstream prediction, and displacement prototype found no prior candidate or receipt.
Prior work freezes downstream readers but still evaluates each target text's own upstream displacement. This screen removes the held row from the upstream prediction rule.
Activation reconstruction and head-vector cosine are explicitly not verdict metrics; only prediction of causal margin effects through the frozen reader counts.
map: For held row i, direction d, and factor subset S, define the exact-subset prototype p[-i,d,S] as the mean grouped-MLP6/7 L11H3 displacement over every other row j with direction d at the same S. Predict q_i(S)=g_d dot p[-i,d,S]. By linearity this equals the leave-one-out mean of the sealed fixed-reader q_hat_j(S), so the causal screen needs no new GPU execution and never reads held-row displacement. The matched direction-cardinality control averages all q_hat_j(T) from other rows j and every subset T with |T|=|S|, removing factor identity at matched held-row exclusion.

predictions.pred_a_instrument_and_complete_join: All three artifact hashes validate; exactly 512 unique row/subset values join; directions/templates/cardinalities match and all source values are finite.
predictions.pred_b_exact_subset_prototype_predicts_a: Across all 512 held-row effects, exact-subset prototypes have cosine >=0.80, relative L2 error <=0.65, and sign agreement >=0.80.
predictions.pred_c_intermediate_compositions_transfe: Across the 448 nonempty/nonfull intermediate subsets, exact-subset prototypes have cosine >=0.75, relative L2 error <=0.70, and sign agreement >=0.75.
predictions.pred_d_each_direction_template_cell_tran: Each of the four direction-template cells has cosine >=0.65, relative L2 error <=0.85, and sign agreement >=0.65.
predictions.pred_e_factor_identity_beats_cardinality: Exact-subset prototypes reduce causal-prediction SSE by at least 10% versus direction-cardinality leave-one-row-out prototypes.
predictions.pred_f_target_free_provenance: Every exact and control prediction excludes the held row, uses only sealed q_hat values and registered metadata, and performs no fit, scale, offset, causal-outcome lookup, target forward, backward, or intervention.

null: Failure of b-d means the upstream displacement law remains lexically/text dependent even though its downstream reader transfers. Failure of e means factor identity adds no reusable upstream structure beyond direction and cardinality. Preserve the result and do not export displacement vectors or tune groupings on this corpus.
